report_title: FY26 Financial Results, Dividend and FY27 Guidance (web-derived)
notes: Polymetallic gold producer (Cobar Basin, NSW). AISC per gold ounce not disclosed (costs reported per tonne processed: A$369/t; group operating costs A$315.3M, sustaining capital A$58.8M). Gold ~55% of revenue. FY26: revenue A$480.2M, EBITDA A$189.2M, NPAT A$82.7M (+69%), op cash flow A$142.8M, cash A$143.9M, no drawn debt, 1.0c fully franked dividend (first in six years). Dargues final ore in FY25 (ceased). FY27 unit cost guidance A$300-330/t. Head grade computed from FY26 gold production, throughput and recovery.

mines.processing: Peak plant (806 kt group throughput @ 2.1 g/t Au, 94.5% Au recovery FY26; expansion to 1.1-1.2 Mtpa underway)
mines.mine_notes: 100% owned. Ore sources: Peak South, New Cobar (513 kt mined FY26). Group FY26 byproducts: Cu 2.5 kt, Zn 28.3 kt, Pb 17.8 kt. Group gold split by mine not disclosed (Peak is the plant and dominant ore source). Tailings Thickener commissioned Q4 FY26; Tertiary Ball Mill due Q1 FY27; regulatory approval for expansion received Aug 2026.

100% owned. Ramp-up ahead of plan: 360 kt ore mined FY26 (~30 kt ahead of plan), 5,683m development; annualised mining rate >400 kt. Mined grades (DecQ FY26): Au 1.23-1.37 g/t, Zn 7.75-8.18%, Pb 4.29-4.61%. Individual gold production not disclosed (included in group 50.4 koz).

mines.processing: Hera plant on care & maintenance (restart option under evaluation)
mines.mine_notes: Cobar region. Hera Processing Plant restart option listed in company growth platform. No FY26 production.

High-grade copper-gold deposit 1.5 km north of New Cobar. Feasibility Study: 3.6 Mt, ~77 kt Cu, 84 koz Au, 505 koz Ag over 8-year mine life; first ore targeted FY28, steady-state 500 ktpa from FY30. Funded from operating cash flows. No FY26 production.
